# Spain Basque Country Crop fields

Spain Basque Country field boundaries (2025) as fiboa GeoParquet + PMTiles, mirrored by Fields of the World from Gobierno Vasco. License: CC-BY-4.0.

- Latest: https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_pv/latest/es_pv.parquet
- All editions: s3://ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_pv/year=*/*.parquet (S3 via endpoint https://data.source.coop, path style, anonymous; hive_partitioning=true adds `year`)
- CRS EPSG:25830; `metrics:area` in m²; `year` = edition, `id` unique per edition only.
- Columns: id, collection, crop:code, crop:name, geometry, bbox
- Docs: https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_pv/README.md, agent guide https://source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_pv/AGENTS.md, STAC https://data.source.coop/ftw/harmonized-field-data/es_pv/collection.json
